review_questions: Independently assess whether AUTO_MODE and MANUAL_MODE are separated from review authority semantics correctly.
Assess whether primary R1 may recommend review without being able to waive deterministic REQUIRED review.
Assess whether production MANUAL_MODE using USER_INITIATED_API preserves the same provider API and governance semantics as AUTO_MODE/AUTOMATIC_API.
Assess whether MANUAL_RELAY is safely limited to a fallback transport and cannot redesign or weaken production API review.
Assess whether promotion validates actual ReviewEvidence, semantic review coverage, and shared-memory grounding instead of caller-supplied authority flags.
Assess reviewer identity provenance, proposer-controlled trigger resistance, superseded-review replay resistance, and selected-reviewer binding.

Assess whether the CI-built single-file manual review container embeds all required evidence and reconstructs each reviewed UTF-8 artifact to its recorded raw Git blob SHA-256 and byte length without repository access or separate file uploads.
Assess shared project memory continuity and stale-memory conflict handling across chat/session boundaries.
Assess disposition/evidence consistency: PASS must be impossible when a mandatory review dimension is unavailable, inaccessible, not tested, or insufficient.

Identify any remaining authority bypass, false-green path, transport/mode divergence, evidence gap, reviewer-selection defect, semantic-review defect, single-file packaging defect, or missing adversarial case.
Return an independent disposition without assuming or using the proposer conclusion.

required_review_dimensions.description: AUTO_MODE and MANUAL_MODE may differ only in review initiation, never authority semantics.
R1 trigger/classification choices cannot waive deterministic REQUIRED review.
Reviewer provider/model identity and selected-reviewer binding resist spoofing/substitution.
Only the current ReviewRequest and exact reviewed commit can satisfy promotion.
Promotion consumes actual ReviewEvidence, execution provenance, semantic validation, and deterministic gate state.
Stale or conflicting shared memory cannot become authority or permit promotion.
Automatic and user-initiated provider API failures remain pending/non-authoritative.
The one-file manual review container contains every required evidence artifact/reference for zero-repository-access review.
Reviewer directly inspects the single-file container artifact records and their SHA-256/UTF-8 byte lengths; separate ZIP/raw-file uploads and Markdown reconstruction are not required.
Disposition agrees with structured review coverage and free-text evidence assessment.
Adversarial search for any additional authority bypass or false-green path.
